scope: Desktop renderer Prompt card browsing and batch selection
cause: Normal detail browsing populated selectedIds; the card route used nonempty selectedIds to show its batch bar while card rows had no checkbox.
changes: Separate transient batch intent from normal browsing in the existing Prompt store.
Reuse the visible Checkbox control in virtualized card rows with mouse/keyboard event isolation.
Keep modifier-key and drag selection; stop detail restoration from erasing remaining batch items.
Run folder reset before detail restoration to prevent initial restore from being overwritten.
storageContract: Transient UI state only; no schema, IPC, dependency, or persistence shape change.
